    LevelResolver
    LevelResolver.Builder.build()
    Builds a level resolver combining LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder.config(LevelConfig), LevelResolver.AbstractBuilder.level(Level, String), and LevelResolver.Builder.resolver(LevelResolver) into a single resolver of equal priority (the highest severity/most restrictive level found for a logger name wins), and, if any fallbacks were added, wrapping that in a priority chain where the fallbacks are only consulted for logger names the combined resolver above has no opinion on (resolves to System.Logger.Level.ALL).
